newsitem.title: UK: Hamleys buys Toy Stack for 8.7 million stg.
newsitem.headline: Hamleys buys Toy Stack for 8.7 million stg.

text.p: Hamleys Plc has agreed to acquire retailer Toy Stack for a total of 8.7 million stg, Hamleys said on Friday.
Toy Stack sells a wide range of toys, games and models from 11 stores located mainly in the south of England.
Hamleys will pay 7.7 million stg in cash, the balance being made up of new Hamleys ordinary shares. The deal is conditional on shareholder approval and the listing of the new shares.
Hamleys said it believed it would be able to develop the Toy Stack brand and that the acquisition would be earnings-enhancing in the current year and first full year of trading.
In the year to end-January, Toy Stack had pre-tax profit of 1.7 million stg on sales of 10.5 million. Toy Stack had net assets of 3.5 million stg as of its year end.
David Fogel, who founded the company when he opened a toy store in the outer London suburbs in 1975, will be paid a net dividend of 1.44 million stg prior to completion.
Fogel has been asked to join the board of Hamleys as buying and merchandising director.
